title: Kerberos Trust Relationship Configuration for Linux Server

blocks.text: Kerberos support in Linux is provided by either the MIT Kerberos package or the Heimdal package. Use the appropriate version available with your distribution. The Kerberos configuration file is in /etc/krb5.conf. The following image is a sample configuration file. Only the text in blue is the Zscaler-specific configuration. It is assumed that Kerberos authentication has been configured and is operational.

blocks.text: To configure Firefox, do the following:

blocks.item: In the address bar of Firefox, enter about:config to display the advanced configuration options.
In the Filter field, enter negotiate to narrow down the list.
Set the following field to the respective values:
If authentication fails, open a terminal and execute the following commands:
user@linux~$ export MOZ_LOG=negotiateauth:5 user@linux~$ export MOZ_LOG_FILE=/tmp/firefox-debug.log user@linux~$ firefox
The file /tmp/firefox-debug.log contains the trace of events that might be useful when investigating issues.
